dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The lateral flank displays several prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with irregular, high-contrast perimeters. The edge geometry consists of jagged light-intensity pixel boundaries that transition sharply from dark exterior fur to lighter-toned interiors, most notably in a central cluster of four distinct rings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A low to moderate density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters is visible along the upper dorsal ridge. These clusters lack an internal gradient and appear as isolated, asymmetrical white specks against the darker coat background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four primary central macro-annuli form an irregular, elongated quadrilateral. A sub-group of three prominent rings forms an obtuse scalene triangle positioned along the lateral midline.
